title: MEDDPICC opportunity qualification
description: Evidence checks for complex sales opportunities that use MEDDPICC.

rules.instruction: Record the buyer's pain, desired outcomes and measurable value. Mark numerical estimates with their assumptions and who confirmed them.
rules.verification: Trace each metric to a buyer source or an explicit estimate, and identify the gaps that need a follow-up before forecast review.

rules.instruction: Distinguish decision criteria, the people involved and the steps to a decision from the steps needed to complete the agreement. Record the economic buyer, champion and competing alternatives only when supported.
rules.verification: Check with the opportunity owner that the next milestone, buyer-side owner and any procurement blockers are evidenced or listed as unknown.

rules.instruction: Choose a next action that resolves the largest qualification gap. Revisit evidence as the buyer's timeline or decisions change.
rules.verification: At the next review, check what changed, which evidence supports the stage and whether the close date still has a buyer-confirmed basis.
